optionsZh: 大量人格描述词被整理为少数宽泛因子。
每种人格特质都属于某个地理大陆。
五个因子分别对应五个具名国家。
心理学家只统计与大城市有关的特质。

entries.prompt: When does the author locate the Big Five’s particularly influential discovery?
options: In 1936 and the early 1940s.
Throughout the entire nineteenth century.
Only after the early 2000s.
In the 1980s and early 1990s.
entries.promptZh: 作者把大五人格这一特别有影响的发现定位于何时？
optionsZh: 整个十九世纪。
仅在 2000 年代初以后。
1980 年代及 1990 年代初。

entries.prompt: What research question do the examples of wrestling and studying abroad introduce?
options: Whether all activities appeal equally to every personality.
Whether studying abroad eliminates differences between people.
Which personality factors are associated with a psychologically rich life.
Which sporting activity guarantees a psychologically rich life.
entries.promptZh: 摔角观赛和留学的例子引出了什么研究问题？
optionsZh: 所有活动是否对每种人格同样有吸引力。
留学是否消除了人与人的差异。
哪些人格因子与心理丰富的人生相关。
哪项体育活动能保证心理丰富的人生。

entries.prompt: Which description matches the data collection reported here?
options: Exactly 5,000 people in one sample from the United States.
More than 5,000 respondents in seven samples across three countries.
Seven respondents in more than 5,000 separate samples.
More than 5,000 respondents drawn only from Korea and India.
entries.promptZh: 哪项符合本句所报告的数据收集范围？
optionsZh: 美国一个样本中恰好 5,000 人。
三个国家的七个样本，共逾 5,000 名受访者。
逾 5,000 个独立样本中共七名受访者。
逾 5,000 名受访者全部只来自韩国和印度。

entries.prompt: Which set correctly matches each example to the life dimension being assessed?
options: Purpose—richness; interesting experiences—happiness; satisfaction—meaning.
Satisfaction—richness; purpose—happiness; interesting experiences—meaning.
Interesting experiences—meaning; satisfaction—happiness; purpose—richness.
Interesting experiences—richness; satisfaction—happiness; purpose—meaning.
entries.promptZh: 哪组把示例与所评估的人生维度正确对应？
optionsZh: 目的—丰富；有趣经历—幸福；满意—意义。
满意—丰富；目的—幸福；有趣经历—意义。
有趣经历—意义；满意—幸福；目的—丰富。
有趣经历—丰富；满意—幸福；目的—意义。

entries.prompt: What did the additional personality questions ask respondents to judge?
options: How well descriptive words characterised them in general.
How often they had met people called imaginative or tense.
Which word was most common in a dictionary.
How much their personality had changed since yesterday.
entries.promptZh: 新增的人格问题要求受访者判断什么？
optionsZh: 描述词在多大程度上概括自己通常的样子。
遇到被称为有想象力或紧张的人的频率。
哪个词在词典中最常见。
自己的人格从昨天起变化了多少。

entries.prompt: What does the comparison with fathers’ and sons’ heights imply about the .47 correlation?
options: It predicts every individual’s psychological richness without error.
It reflects a fairly strong tendency with room for exceptions.
It means exactly 47 percent of open people have rich lives.
It proves that openness alone causes every rich experience.
entries.promptZh: 父子身高的类比说明 .47 这一相关值意味着什么？
optionsZh: 能毫无误差地预测每个人的心理丰富性。
呈现相当强的倾向，但仍容许例外。
恰好 47% 的开放者人生丰富。
证明开放性单独造成每一种丰富经历。

entries.prompt: How does this passage qualify the link between openness and richness?
options: Low openness rules out richness in every case.
High openness guarantees richness despite all other circumstances.
Only people high in openness can be exceptions.
There are exceptions in both directions.
entries.promptZh: 本段怎样限定开放性与丰富性之间的联系？
optionsZh: 低开放性在每个个案中都排除丰富性。
高开放性不受其他条件影响，必定保证丰富性。
只有高开放性者可能成为例外。
两个方向都存在例外。

entries.prompt: Which tendency is specifically reported for students high in openness?
options: They are less likely to pursue intellectual interests.
They prefer routine more than students low in openness.
They are more likely to study abroad than less open students.
They all choose the same artistic subject at university.
entries.promptZh: 本段具体报告高开放性学生具有哪种倾向？
optionsZh: 较不愿追求知识兴趣。
比低开放性学生更偏好惯例。
比低开放性学生更可能留学。
大学里全部选择同一种艺术学科。

entries.prompt: Which sequence best represents the reciprocal relationship the authors propose?
options: Openness encourages enriching activities, which can further increase openness.
Enriching activities eliminate openness, which then prevents later activities.
Personality fixes destiny, so activities cannot make any difference.
Studying abroad benefits only people who are already extraverts.
entries.promptZh: 哪一顺序最符合作者提出的双向关系？
optionsZh: 开放性促成丰富活动，活动又可进一步提高开放性。
丰富活动消除开放性，进而阻止后续活动。
人格决定命运，所以活动毫无作用。
留学只使本来就外向的人获益。

entries.prompt: What limitation does Joy Ryan’s example illustrate?
options: She had no openness until the author measured it at age ninety-four.
Being open ensures abundant travel opportunities from childhood.
Openness alone need not produce rich experiences when opportunities are limited.
The .47 correlation means opportunities have no role in richness.
entries.promptZh: Joy Ryan 的例子说明了什么限制？
optionsZh: 直到作者在她九十四岁测量前，她一直毫无开放性。
只要开放，从童年起就必有丰富旅行机会。
机会有限时，单有开放性不一定带来丰富经历。
.47 的相关意味着机会对丰富性毫无作用。

entries.prompt: Which combination does the author emphasise as opening the door to rich experiences?
options: An open personality with no need for opportunities or resources.
An open personality together with opportunities and resources.
Resources alone, regardless of any opportunity to use them.
A wish to travel as proof that all parks have already been visited.
entries.promptZh: 作者强调什么组合能为丰富经历打开大门？
optionsZh: 开放人格，不需要机会或资源。
开放人格加上机会和资源。
只有资源，不论有没有使用机会。
想旅行就证明已游览全部公园。

entries.prompt: Which account correctly preserves the timing of Simon Ramo’s patents?
options: He received all twenty-five patents at age one hundred.
He received his final patent before turning thirty.
He had sixty-two patents before he was thirty.
He had twenty-five patents before thirty and his last at one hundred.
entries.promptZh: 哪项正确保留了 Simon Ramo 获专利的时间信息？
optionsZh: 全部二十五项专利都在一百岁取得。
最后一项专利在三十岁前取得。
三十岁前有六十二项专利。
三十岁前有二十五项，一百岁获得最后一项。

entries.prompt: What reason is given for Ramo’s move from large corporations to his own company?
options: He became tired of corporate bureaucracy.
He had stopped being interested in engineering.
He needed a company devoted only to tennis books.
His employer required him to become a barber.
entries.promptZh: 本段给出 Ramo 离开大公司、创办自己公司的什么原因？
optionsZh: 他厌倦了公司官僚作风。
他不再对工程感兴趣。
他需要一家只写网球书的公司。
雇主要求他改当理发师。

entries.prompt: How does the author use Ramo’s “registered opportunist” reply?
options: As evidence that he had formally registered a new political party.
To illustrate humor and interests not confined to one belief system.
To establish that he had no interest in the world around him.
As a definition of the only acceptable personality type.
entries.promptZh: 作者怎样使用 Ramo 那句“登记在册的机会主义者”的回答？
optionsZh: 证明他正式登记成立了新政党。
表现幽默及不受单一信仰体系束缚的兴趣。
证明他对周遭世界毫无兴趣。
定义唯一可接受的人格类型。

entries.prompt: What does the passage say Cha did NOT do after the 1955–1972 writing period?
options: Transfer to his newspaper’s Hong Kong office during that period.
Become known under the name Jin Yong.
Write any new novels after that period.
Write novels inspired by martial arts history during that period.
entries.promptZh: 本段说，1955–1972 年创作期之后，Cha 没有再做什么？
optionsZh: 在该时期转到报纸香港办事处。
以 Jin Yong 这个名字为人所知。
在该时期之后再写新小说。
在该时期写受武术历史启发的小说。

entries.prompt: What did Cha continue doing instead of producing new novels?
options: Replacing every favorite character with a historical journalist.
Moving all his writing work back to Shanghai.
Revising only the newspaper articles of other writers.
Rereading and revising his own novels.
entries.promptZh: Cha 没有再写新小说，而是继续做什么？
optionsZh: 把所有喜爱的人物换成历史记者。
把全部写作工作搬回上海。
只修订其他作者的报纸文章。
重读并修订自己的小说。

entries.prompt: What contrast does “Yet” introduce in the account of Cha’s life?
options: His life was turbulent and not worry-free, but still unique and interesting.
His escape guaranteed that he never faced any worries.
His life was uninteresting because he spent almost a year abroad.
His happiness is presented as the cause of his escape.
entries.promptZh: Yet 在 Cha 人生的叙述中引出什么对照？
optionsZh: 生活动荡、并非无忧，却仍独特有趣。
逃离保证他再无任何忧虑。
在外近一年使他的人生变得无趣。
他的幸福被说成逃离的原因。

entries.prompt: Which distinction between the two subfactors is described?
options: Openness predicts only scientific work, while intellect excludes the arts.
Both subfactors are described as having no connection with creativity.
Openness is linked with creative arts, while intellect is linked with arts and sciences.
Intellect and openness are simply two names for the same subfactor.
entries.promptZh: 本段怎样区分两个子因子？
optionsZh: 开放子因子只对应科学，智性排除艺术。
两个子因子都与创造无关。
开放子因子与艺术创造有关，智性与艺术和科学创造都有关。
智性与开放只是同一子因子的两个名称。

entries.prompt: Which statement best paraphrases the author’s proposed distinction?
options: Openness and extraversion both concern only abstract ideas.
Openness explores sensory and abstract information; extraversion explores people.
Extraversion means avoiding interpersonal information.
Openness concerns social status, while extraversion concerns intelligence tests.
entries.promptZh: 哪项最贴近作者提出的区分？
optionsZh: 开放性与外向性都只关乎抽象观念。
开放性探索感官与抽象信息；外向性探索他人。
外向性意味着回避人际信息。
开放性关乎社会地位，外向性关乎智力测试。

entries.prompt: What reason does the sentence give for linking more interaction with richer experiences?
options: Every conversation is equally pleasant.
Meeting people removes all differences between them.
Rich experiences require talking only to existing friends.
People differ, so interacting with more people increases experiential variety.
entries.promptZh: 本句给出什么理由，把更多互动与更丰富的经历联系起来？
optionsZh: 每次谈话都同样愉快。
结识他人会消除他们之间的一切差异。
丰富经历要求只和老朋友交谈。
人各有不同，因此更多互动增加经历的多样性。

entries.prompt: How does the author describe his own usual behaviour at a party?
options: He tends to stay with one or two familiar people for a deeper conversation.
He tries to meet every new person and avoids familiar faces.
He refuses to speak to anyone he already knows.
He describes his strategy as identical to an extravert’s.
entries.promptZh: 作者怎样描述自己在聚会中通常的表现？
optionsZh: 倾向与一两位熟人待在一起，作较深入的交谈。
努力结识每位陌生人，回避熟面孔。
拒绝与任何已认识的人说话。
认为自己的策略与外向者完全相同。

entries.prompt: Why might an extraverted friend expand someone’s social network more?
options: Extraverts have fewer friends, leaving more room in each network.
Extraverts tend to have more friends, offering links to a wider network.
A single friendship guarantees meeting every kind of person.
Extraverts learn new things only from introverted friends.
entries.promptZh: 为什么一位外向朋友可能更能扩展一个人的社交网络？
optionsZh: 外向者朋友更少，网络因此有更多空位。
外向者通常朋友更多，可通向更广的关系网络。
一段友谊保证结识每种人。
外向者只能从内向朋友学到新东西。

entries.prompt: Which wording best preserves the meaning of “is linked to” in this sentence?
options: Is associated with.
Is completely identical to.
Is the only possible cause of.
Is incompatible with.
entries.promptZh: 哪种表达最能保留本句 is linked to 的含义？
optionsZh: 与……相关联。
与……完全相同。
是……唯一可能的原因。
与……无法并存。

entries.prompt: Which factor is offered to explain why extraverts explore the social world more?
options: Their certainty that no conversation can ever go badly.
Their wish to avoid every unfamiliar person.
Their confidence and self-assurance.
Their fear of losing all existing friendships.
entries.promptZh: 作者提出什么因素，解释外向者更多探索社交世界？
optionsZh: 确信没有任何谈话会出问题。
希望避开所有不熟悉的人。
自信与自我确信。
害怕失去全部现有友谊。

entries.prompt: How does the passage connect confidence with starting a conversation?
options: Confidence makes people focus more on every possible negative judgment.
Greater confidence makes entering a new conversation more likely.
Confidence removes any need to learn from other people.
Confidence guarantees that every story told will be interesting.
entries.promptZh: 本段怎样把自信与开始谈话联系起来？
optionsZh: 自信使人更关注每一种可能的负面评价。
越自信，越可能加入新的谈话。
自信消除了向别人学习的需要。
自信保证每个讲出的故事都很有趣。

entries.prompt: Which sequence best reflects the passage’s account of parties?
options: A rich party experience makes another party impossible.
Fewer conversations always produce a richer party experience.
Attending one party proves that someone will attend every later party.
More conversations enrich the experience, which may encourage another visit.
entries.promptZh: 哪一顺序最符合本段对聚会经历的解释？
optionsZh: 一次丰富的聚会经历使参加下一次成为不可能。
谈话越少，聚会总是越丰富。
参加一次聚会证明以后每次都会去。
更多谈话丰富经历，而这种经历可能鼓励再次参加。

entries.prompt: What did the cited study report about extraverts in college?
options: They participated in more college activities than introverts.
They all joined every campus organisation.
They took part only in athletic activities.
They had less energy than introverts but more free time.
entries.promptZh: 所引研究报告了大学外向者的什么情况？
optionsZh: 他们比内向者参与更多大学活动。
他们全都加入每个校园组织。
他们只参加体育活动。
他们精力比内向者少，但空闲时间更多。

entries.prompt: Which comparison is actually made about Joy Ryan?
options: She has visited more parks than every younger traveller.
She is more energetic than every other person her age.
She is full of energy compared with other people in their nineties.
She is unable to reach remote parks despite her energy.
entries.promptZh: 本段实际对 Joy Ryan 作了哪种比较？
optionsZh: 她比每位年轻旅行者游览的公园都多。
她比其他所有同龄人都有精力。
与其他九十多岁的人相比，她精力充沛。
尽管有精力，她仍无法到达偏远公园。

entries.prompt: How is Mr. Rogers introduced as an example of a happy person?
options: As a participant whose mood was measured after a laboratory task.
As a governor discussing social policy.
As a traveller who avoids singing and dancing.
As a cheerful, friendly neighbour in a television show.
entries.promptZh: Mr. Rogers 被怎样引入，作为幸福人物的例子？
optionsZh: 完成实验任务后接受情绪测量的参与者。
讨论社会政策的州长。
回避歌舞的旅行者。
电视节目中面带愉快笑容的友善邻居。

entries.prompt: What is the effect of the question “Who wouldn’t want to hang out with a guy” here?
options: It reports a survey in which nobody liked the character.
It enthusiastically suggests that the character is appealing company.
It asks the reader to calculate how many people avoid television.
It establishes that every viewer has personally met the character.
entries.promptZh: 这里 Who wouldn’t want to hang out with a guy 这一问法有什么作用？
optionsZh: 报告一项没有人喜欢该角色的调查。
热情暗示这个角色是令人愿意相伴的人。
要求读者计算有多少人回避电视。
确立每位观众都亲自见过该角色。

entries.prompt: Which trait is excluded from the happy-life pattern reported in the meta-analysis?
options: Emotional stability.
Conscientiousness.
Openness to experiences.
Agreeableness.
entries.promptZh: 这项元分析所报告的幸福人生模式，没有把哪个特质包括在内？
optionsZh: 情绪稳定性。
尽责性。
经验开放性。
宜人性。

entries.prompt: Why does the author say the two strongest predictors of happiness “make sense”?
options: Their affective meanings align with a definition emphasising positive over negative emotions.
They prove that happy people never experience negative emotion.
They show that openness is the same thing as emotional stability.
Their names demonstrate that personality never changes.
entries.promptZh: 作者为什么说幸福的两项最强预测因素“合乎道理”？
optionsZh: 它们的情感含义与积极情绪占优势、消极情绪相对较少的定义一致。
它们证明幸福者从不体验消极情绪。
它们说明开放性与情绪稳定性是同一概念。
它们的名称证明人格永不改变。

entries.prompt: What limited conclusion is supported by the two travel-related examples?
options: All people who travel have exactly the same level of happiness.
Being open to experience prevents a person from being happy.
Rick Steves and Anthony Bourdain were measured in a laboratory experiment here.
Openness can coexist with different levels of happiness.
entries.promptZh: 两个与旅行有关的人物例子支持什么有限结论？
optionsZh: 所有旅行者的幸福水平完全一样。
对经验开放会阻止一个人幸福。
Rick Steves 与 Anthony Bourdain 在这里接受了实验室测量。
开放性可以与不同的幸福水平并存。

entries.prompt: What main link is proposed between the listed personality traits and happiness?
options: The traits remove all need for social relationships.
The traits are connected with good relationships, whose quality predicts happiness.
Happiness depends only on being popular with strangers.
The traits ensure that every relationship is free from disagreement.
entries.promptZh: 作者在人格特质与幸福之间提出什么主要联系？
optionsZh: 这些特质消除了社交关系的所有需要。
这些特质与良好关系相联，而关系质量能预测幸福。
幸福只取决于受陌生人欢迎。
这些特质确保每段关系都没有分歧。

entries.prompt: What does “emotionally volatile” mean in this description?
options: Prone to rapid or unpredictable emotional changes.
Consistently calm with little emotional fluctuation.
Skilled at recalling every past feeling accurately.
Unable to experience any emotion at all.
entries.promptZh: 这里 emotionally volatile 是什么意思？
optionsZh: 容易出现快速或难以预测的情绪变化。
始终平静，情绪几乎不波动。
善于准确回忆过去每种感受。
完全无法体验任何情绪。

entries.prompt: Why mention deadlines and family birthdays in this passage?
options: To argue that remembering dates removes every financial problem.
To show that family occasions are the only basis of happiness.
To illustrate the practical effort involved in maintaining stability.
To suggest avoiding any task that feels unpleasant.
entries.promptZh: 这里为什么提到截止日期与家人的生日？
optionsZh: 论证记住日期能消除所有财务问题。
说明家庭场合是幸福的唯一基础。
举例说明维持稳定需要付出的实际努力。
建议回避任何令人不愉快的任务。

entries.prompt: Which conclusion about a boss’s liking is justified by the wording?
options: It guarantees both a raise and a promotion.
It is associated here with a greater chance of a raise or promotion.
It makes work relationships irrelevant to a career.
It proves that every well-liked employee works harder.
entries.promptZh: 关于上司的喜欢，本段措辞支持哪项结论？
optionsZh: 保证同时加薪和晋升。
在此被描述为与更高的加薪或晋升机会相联。
它使工作关系与职业毫无关系。
证明每位受欢迎的员工都更努力。

entries.prompt: What does “a boon” mean in this account of coping with bad events?
options: A guarantee that bad events will never happen.
A permanent cause of difficult circumstances.
A requirement to suppress every negative feeling.
A helpful benefit or advantage.
entries.promptZh: 在应对坏事的叙述中，a boon 是什么意思？
optionsZh: 坏事永不发生的保证。
困难处境的永久原因。
压抑所有负面感受的要求。
一种有帮助的益处或优势。

entries.prompt: How should the proposed explanation involving exploration be interpreted?
options: As one possible reason, since exploration can have different kinds of outcomes.
As proof that trying a new restaurant always increases happiness.
As evidence that open people never have unpleasant experiences.
As a claim that every exploration necessarily reduces happiness.
entries.promptZh: 涉及探索的解释，应怎样理解？
optionsZh: 一种可能原因，因为探索可能带来不同结果。
证明尝试新餐厅总会增加幸福。
证明开放者从不遇到不愉快的经历。
声称每次探索都必定减少幸福。

entries.prompt: What relationship does “antithetical to” express here?
options: A necessary precondition for.
In opposition to.
An exact synonym for.
A numerical measure of.
entries.promptZh: 这里 antithetical to 表达什么关系？
optionsZh: 是……必要的先决条件。
与……相对立。
是……完全同义的表达。
是……的数值测量。

entries.prompt: Why introduce Thunberg and Huckabee as being at opposite political ends?
options: To establish that they support the same policies.
To show that meaningful lives require one particular party membership.
To report a controlled experiment comparing their personalities.
To ask what personalities may share despite different political positions.
entries.promptZh: 为什么指出 Thunberg 与 Huckabee 位于政治光谱的两端？
optionsZh: 确立他们支持相同政策。
说明有意义人生要求加入某个特定政党。
报告比较两人人格的对照实验。
询问政治立场不同的人，其人格可能有什么共同之处。

entries.prompt: Which account matches the start of Greta’s protest as narrated in the book?
options: At nineteen, she protested daily inside the Swedish parliament.
At fifteen, she protested every Friday outside a university.
At fifteen, she protested every Friday in front of the Swedish parliament.
At fifteen, she began a campaign against all school education.
entries.promptZh: 哪项符合书中叙述的 Greta 抗议起点？
optionsZh: 十九岁时，每天在瑞典议会内部抗议。
十五岁时，每周五在一所大学外抗议。
十五岁时，每周五在瑞典议会前抗议。
十五岁时开始反对一切学校教育的运动。

entries.prompt: What do the school break and relentless work illustrate in the author’s description?
options: The priority and sustained effort she gives to her activism.
The end of her interest in environmental issues.
A requirement that every meaningful life must abandon school.
An equal division of all her commitments in 2019.
entries.promptZh: 作者描述的暂时离校与不懈工作，说明什么？
optionsZh: 她把行动工作放在优先位置，并持续付出努力。
她不再对环境议题感兴趣。
每种有意义人生都必须离开学校。
她在 2019 年平均分配所有事务。

entries.prompt: What is given as the connection between Huckabee’s pastoral work and his move into politics?
options: His college required every religion student to become a governor.
He stopped listening to people once he became a pastor.
His work for a televangelist prevented any later public role.
Hearing policy-related personal struggles led him toward politics.
entries.promptZh: 本段怎样联系 Huckabee 的牧师工作与从政？
optionsZh: 大学要求每位宗教学生都成为州长。
当牧师后，他停止听别人倾诉。
电视布道者的工作阻止他此后担任任何公共职务。
听到与政策有关的个人困境，使他转向政治。

entries.prompt: What does the food example illustrate about Huckabee’s presentation of policy views?
options: He cites a scientific estimate of the actual danger posed by refugees.
He uses a food analogy while framing policy through his beliefs.
He gives nutritional advice unrelated to any policy issue.
He argues that every policy should be decided by laboratory food tests.
entries.promptZh: 食物例子说明 Huckabee 怎样表达政策观点？
optionsZh: 他引用科学估计，说明难民实际带来的危险。
他从自身信念出发讨论政策，并使用食物类比。
他给出与政策无关的营养建议。
他主张每项政策都应由食品实验决定。

entries.prompt: What does “probably” signal about the explanation of Huckabee’s sense of meaning?
options: The book reports his exact answer to a meaning questionnaire.
The author has proved that all religious people share the same motivation.
The author offers an interpretation rather than a directly verified inner report.
Huckabee is described as having no clear guiding principles.
entries.promptZh: 解释 Huckabee 的意义感时，probably 表示什么？
optionsZh: 书中报告了他在意义感问卷上的确切回答。
作者已证明所有宗教人士的动机相同。
作者给出解释性推测，而非直接核实的内心自报。
书中说他没有明确的指导原则。

entries.prompt: Which trait is ranked first, and which least, in the pattern described for meaningful lives?
options: Conscientiousness first; openness to experience least.
Openness to experience first; conscientiousness least.
Extraversion first; emotional stability least.
Agreeableness first; extraversion least.
entries.promptZh: 本句给出的有意义人生特征中，哪个排第一，哪个最弱？
optionsZh: 尽责性第一，经验开放性最弱。

Personality traits determine with certainty who will have a rich life.

人格特质能确定无疑地决定谁的人生丰富。
作者用 Goldmund 作说明性例子。

Their rich experiences are limited to visiting parks with Brad personally.
They are excluded from rich lives because they prefer fewer social contacts.

optionsZh: 可通过知识探索或他人带动获得丰富经历。

丰富经历只限于亲自和 Brad 游公园。
因偏好较少社交而被排除在人生丰富之外。

entries.prompt: Which use of other personality traits does the author recommend?
options: Rejecting a partner’s suggestions to protect every existing routine.
Treating emotional stability as proof that new experiences are unnecessary.
Working conscientiously toward openness and accepting suggestions for adventure.
Waiting for all personality traits to become perfect before exploring anything.
entries.promptZh: 作者建议怎样运用其他人格特质？
optionsZh: 拒绝伴侣建议以保护所有惯例。
把情绪稳定当成不必有新经历的证明。
认真努力地提高开放性，并乐于接受冒险建议。
等所有人格特质完美后才开始探索。

entries.prompt: How strongly are the explanations for happiness presented here?
options: As the single proven cause of every happy life.
As partial explanations, with some explicitly qualified by “perhaps”.
As evidence that agreeable people never face disagreement.
As a denial that goal achievement has any relationship with happiness.
entries.promptZh: 本段以多强的确定程度解释幸福？
optionsZh: 每种幸福人生唯一且已证实的原因。
部分解释，其中一些明确用 perhaps 限定。
证明宜人者从不遭遇任何分歧。
否认目标实现与幸福有任何联系。

entries.prompt: What capacity is linked with meaning in this passage?
options: Changing causes whenever a minor worry appears.
Avoiding any lasting commitment to other people.
Eliminating every possible concern before taking action.
Devoting sustained effort to a few causes without excessive worry.
entries.promptZh: 本段把哪种能力与意义感联系起来？
optionsZh: 一出现小担忧就换事业。
回避对他人的任何长期投入。
行动前消除每一种可能的担忧。
不过度担忧，长期投入少数几项事业。

Openness has no place in any good life.

Happiness and meaning are ruled out for anyone open to experience.
entries.promptZh: 人格关联因素的总结，核心对比是什么？
optionsZh: 开放性在三个维度都同样占主导。
开放性在任何美好人生中都无作用。
开放性在丰富性中的作用，大于它在幸福或意义中的作用。
开放者不可能拥有幸福或意义。

options: Use self-understanding and trait–life associations to develop strategies for a good life.
Use a personality score to assign every person a fixed destiny.
Take one test as a substitute for any later personal effort.
Choose the same life strategy regardless of any differences in personality.
entries.promptZh: 作者建议怎样实际运用人格知识？
optionsZh: 利用自我认识及特质与人生维度的关联，制定美好人生策略。
用人格分数给每个人分配固定命运。
做一次测试就替代此后所有努力。
无论人格怎样不同，都采用完全相同策略。

entries.prompt: What is the purpose of the final encouragement to “Keep on reading”?

To introduce practical tips while stressing that personality can change with effort.
To claim that reading alone instantly changes every personality trait.
To announce that the book has finished discussing psychological richness.
entries.promptZh: 结尾鼓励 Keep on reading 的用意是什么？
optionsZh: 坚持只有原本高开放性者才能获益。
引出实际方法，并强调人格能随努力改变。
宣称只读文字就能立刻改变所有特质。
宣布全书已结束心理丰富性的讨论。

Practise household tasks for a fixed number of hours.
Become more open by taking a prescribed vacation.
Complete various unfinished sentences.

按固定时数练习家务。
通过规定的度假提高开放性。
补全各种未完成的句子。

entries.prompt: Which interpretation respects the contrasting housework responses?

说明所有开放男性实际拒绝全部家务。
证明研究者观察了两人的私人家庭。
确立勉强做家务使所有人不开放。

entries.prompt: What degree of certainty is conveyed by “may be central”?

The three qualities have been ruled out as irrelevant.
The qualities are proposed as potentially important to both openness and richness.
Everyone must display all three qualities before having any rich experience.
entries.promptZh: may be central 表达什么确定程度？
optionsZh: 已证明玩心是丰富性的唯一原因。
已排除这三种特质，认定它们无关。
提出这些特质可能对开放性与丰富性都重要。
每个人必须先同时具备三者，才可能有任何丰富经历。

entries.prompt: What does Erikson’s “on vacation” expression suggest in context?

Playfulness offers a temporary release from ordinary adult demands.
Only a paid trip to another country can count as play.
Social and economic obligations are imaginary and do not exist.

玩心使人暂时从日常成年生活要求中抽离。
只有付费出国旅行才算玩。
社会与经济义务是不存在的幻想。

Replacing fantasy with financial planning at all times.
Imitating Curry while playing basketball and pretending to be Ebert while watching a film.

与 Steph Curry 一起训练，并受雇于 Roger Ebert。
始终用财务规划取代想象。
打篮球时模仿 Curry，看电影时假装像 Ebert。

Prove that someone on the news is not real.

依法就任对方的职务。
代表政府撰写正式报告。
证明新闻中的某人不存在。

A metaphor for temporary escape or self-forgetting.
entries.promptZh: 这段文学引语中的 opium 暗示什么？
optionsZh: 研究者处方中经过测量的医疗治疗。
实际加进表演者食物的物质。
证明音乐永久消除一切职业问题。
暂时逃离或忘却自我的比喻。

entries.prompt: Which pairing of Sidis’s ages and events matches the passage?
options: At eight he lectured at Harvard; at eleven he first sat the two exams.
At eight he earned a medical degree; at eleven he entered MIT.
At eight he passed the named exams; at eleven he lectured on astrophysics at Harvard.
At eleven he passed the exams and stopped studying astrophysics.
entries.promptZh: 哪组 Sidis 的年龄与事件对应原文？
optionsZh: 八岁在 Harvard 演讲，十一岁才参加两项考试。
八岁取得医学学位，十一岁入读 MIT。
八岁通过所列考试，十一岁在 Harvard 讲天体物理。
十一岁通过考试后停止学习天体物理。

entries.prompt: How should “might” and “could” affect the interpretation of the final claim?
options: They present possible risks rather than a guaranteed outcome for every early specialist.
They prove that early specialisation was Sidis’s only cause of burnout.
They establish that the professor’s prediction was correct.
They show that no early specialist can retain other interests.
entries.promptZh: might 与 could 应怎样影响对结尾论断的理解？
optionsZh: 它们提出可能风险，而非每位早期专攻者必然遭遇的结果。
它们证明早期专攻是 Sidis 倦怠的唯一原因。
它们确立那位教授的预测正确。
它们表明早期专攻者都无法保有其他兴趣。

entries.prompt: What does the author do with the phrase “makes me wonder if”?
options: Announce that persistence has no value in any profession.
Raise the possibility that single-minded grit should be accompanied by playfulness.
Report a completed trial proving a treatment for depression.
Conclude that every elite athlete and academic is depressed.
entries.promptZh: 作者用 makes me wonder if 做什么？
optionsZh: 宣布坚持对任何职业都无价值。
提出单一目标的坚毅是否应与玩心相伴这一可能。
报告已完成的试验，证明一种抑郁治疗。
断定每位精英运动员与学者都抑郁。

entries.prompt: What qualification applies to the twenty-two postseason games mentioned here?
options: Every team is guaranteed to play exactly twenty-two.
They replace the 162 regular-season games.
They are an upper limit, expressed as “up to”.
They refer to twenty-two training hours each week.
entries.promptZh: 这里提到二十二场季后赛，有什么限定？
optionsZh: 每支球队都保证恰好打二十二场。
它们取代 162 场常规赛。
它们是 up to 所表达的上限。
它们指每周二十二小时训练。

entries.prompt: How is Ohtani’s action with his bat used in the passage?
options: As evidence that a bat needed medical treatment to function.
As proof that humour always causes elite performance.
As a report that he stopped caring about his sport completely.
As an example of a joking response to difficulty that appears to help him relax.
entries.promptZh: 作者怎样使用 Ohtani 对球棒所做的动作？
optionsZh: 证明球棒需要医疗处理才可使用。
证明幽默总能导致顶级表现。
报告他已彻底不在意运动。
作为面对困难时开玩笑、似乎有助放松的例子。

entries.prompt: What does the chess-game comparison suggest about baseball here?
options: It is becoming more analytical and logical, with playfulness restoring some fun.
Baseball has literally replaced its balls and bats with chess pieces.
Data analysis is said to have made every game more spontaneous and silly.
The author argues that humour has no place in professional work.
entries.promptZh: 这里把棒球比作棋局，意在暗示什么？
optionsZh: 比赛越来越重分析和逻辑，而轻松态度可恢复一些趣味。
棒球实际已用棋子取代球棒和球。
数据分析使每场比赛都更即兴、更胡闹。
作者认为职业工作不应有幽默。

entries.prompt: Whom does Shaq praise as exceptionally hard-working in the interview quotation?
options: Patrick Bet-David.
Shohei Ohtani.
Kobe Bryant.
Every player on the team without distinction.
entries.promptZh: 访谈引语中，Shaq 赞扬谁格外勤奋？
optionsZh: 帕特里克·贝特-戴维（Patrick Bet-David）。
大谷翔平（Shohei Ohtani）。
科比·布莱恩特（Kobe Bryant）。
全队每个人，不作区别。

entries.prompt: What does Shaq’s account of life after training help illustrate?
options: He had no responsibilities outside basketball.
His work coexisted with family and business roles, supporting the idea of different paths to success.
He claimed that two to three hours of work guarantees success for everyone.
He had abandoned both parenthood and business to train constantly.
entries.promptZh: Shaq 对训练后生活的叙述，有助于说明什么？
optionsZh: 篮球之外他没有责任。
工作与家庭、商业角色并存，呼应成功可有不同道路。
他声称任何人只工作二三小时都保证成功。
他为不断训练而放弃父亲角色与商业事务。

entries.prompt: What does the counterfactual about Shaq’s work ethic allow the reader to conclude?
options: More achievement and earlier burnout are both presented as possibilities, not established outcomes.
Kobe’s work ethic definitely would have prevented any burnout in Shaq.
Shaq actually adopted Kobe’s exact work routine and was experimentally tested.
The passage proves that Shaq won no major awards.
entries.promptZh: 关于 Shaq 敬业精神的反事实，允许读者得出什么？
optionsZh: 更多成就与更早倦怠都作为可能提出，并非已确立结果。
Kobe 的投入方式肯定会使 Shaq 永无倦怠。
Shaq 实际照搬 Kobe 作息并接受实验测量。
本段证明 Shaq 未获任何大奖。

entries.prompt: What does “Even so” add to the acknowledgement of work ethic?
options: Work ethic is irrelevant to success.
Playfulness has already been proved to replace all practice.
Only carefree people can enter competitive professions.
Playfulness may also contribute to long-term success despite the importance of effort.
entries.promptZh: 承认敬业精神重要后，Even so 补充什么？
optionsZh: 敬业精神与成功无关。
已证明玩心可取代全部练习。
只有无忧无虑的人才可进入竞争职业。
即使努力重要，玩心也可能有助长期成功。

entries.prompt: Which personality pattern is attributed to playfulness in this excerpt?
options: High conscientiousness with no openness or extraversion.
A complete absence of every personality trait.
Openness and extraversion combined with relatively less conscientiousness and neuroticism.
Neuroticism alone, with no other trait involved.
entries.promptZh: 本片段把玩心归于什么人格组合？
optionsZh: 高尽责性，没有开放性或外向性。
所有人格特质都完全不存在。
开放性与外向性，并相对较少尽责性和神经质。
只有神经质，不涉及任何其他特质。

entries.prompt: Which statement best preserves the description of playful people?
options: They never treat any situation seriously.
They avoid every responsibility regardless of context.
They always worry about presenting themselves as important.
They do not overvalue their own seriousness and seem able to adjust to the situation.
entries.promptZh: 哪项最保留这句对有玩心者的描述？
optionsZh: 他们对任何情况都不认真。
他们不论情境都回避所有责任。
他们总担心怎样显得重要。
他们不过度严肃地看待自己，似乎能按情况调整态度。

entries.prompt: What did the randomly assigned counting group do in the recent study?
options: Receive a fixed programme requiring more outdoor vacations.
Count their own playful activities each day for one week.
Measure the personality of every person they met for a year.
Avoid noticing anything playful until the study ended.
entries.promptZh: 近期研究中，被随机分到记录组的参与者做什么？
optionsZh: 接受要求增加户外假期的固定安排。
连续一周每天清点自己做过的有玩心的事。
全年测量遇到每个人的人格。
研究结束前避免注意任何好玩的事。

entries.prompt: Which distinction between evidence and speculation is explicit in this passage?
options: Satisfaction and depression were reported outcomes; greater psychological richness is the author’s unmeasured expectation.
Psychological richness was measured, but satisfaction was not.
The intervention proved equal improvements in every dimension for every participant.
The authors measured only meaning and ignored all other outcomes.
entries.promptZh: 本段明确区分了哪种证据与推测？
optionsZh: 满意度与抑郁是所报告的结果；心理丰富性提升是作者对未测维度的预期。
心理丰富性测了，满意度没测。
干预证明每人在每个维度都同等改善。
研究者只测意义，忽略其他结果。

entries.prompt: Why are the sitcoms and Samantha mentioned?
options: To establish a survey of how all real friends manage appointments.
To show that friendship requires living inside a television studio.
To illustrate an appealing image of spontaneity and how friends may encourage it.
To argue that planned interactions cannot be enjoyable.
entries.promptZh: 为什么提到情景喜剧和 Samantha？
optionsZh: 确立所有现实朋友如何约时间的调查结果。
说明友谊必须发生在电视摄影棚。
描绘自发性的吸引人形象，以及朋友可能带来的带动作用。
论证计划好的互动都不可能愉快。

entries.prompt: When did the author describe almost daily informal coffee with someone?
options: Only after he stopped seeing all his graduate-school friends.
During graduate school, when many friends were nearby at school.
After every colleague had scheduled a meeting two weeks ahead.
Only during planned annual outings with his wife.
entries.promptZh: 作者何时几乎每天都与人随意喝咖啡？
optionsZh: 仅在不再见研究生朋友之后。
研究生时期，许多朋友都在学校附近时。
每位同事都提前两周预约之后。
仅在与妻子计划好的年度出游中。

entries.prompt: What does “unplanned” indicate about the lunches?
options: They never happened despite being scheduled.
They were always eaten alone.
They happened exactly once, at a formal appointment.
They were not arranged in advance.
entries.promptZh: unplanned 说明这些午餐怎样？
optionsZh: 虽已排程却从未发生。
总是独自吃。
只发生一次，且正式预约。
事先没有安排好。

entries.prompt: What happened when the author first invited the nearby assistant professor for coffee?
options: The colleague immediately accepted and left his office.
The author sent a formal invitation before taking the faculty job.
The author dropped by and invited him, but the colleague said he could not.
The colleague invited the author to a laboratory across town.
entries.promptZh: 作者最初邀请附近助理教授喝咖啡时，发生什么？
optionsZh: 对方立即接受并离开办公室。
作者取得教职前先寄正式邀请。
作者顺路敲门邀请，对方却说不行。
对方邀请作者到城另一头的实验室。

entries.prompt: What aspect of the reply appears to stun the author?
options: A casual coffee invitation turned into a calendar check and a proposal for two weeks later.
The colleague had forgotten that coffee existed.
The PDA proved the colleague had no responsibilities.
The colleague refused any contact for the rest of his life.
entries.promptZh: 回答的什么方面似乎使作者惊讶？
optionsZh: 随意喝咖啡的邀请变成查日程、约两周后。
同事忘记咖啡的存在。
PDA 证明同事毫无责任。
同事拒绝此后终身任何联系。

entries.prompt: What does the advice to be “stingy with my time” mean?
options: Spend all available time with every visitor.
Refuse to pay money for coffee.
Work without ever considering productivity.
Be sparing about giving time away, to protect productivity.
entries.promptZh: be stingy with my time 这条建议是什么意思？
optionsZh: 把所有时间都给每位访客。
拒绝付咖啡钱。
工作时完全不考虑产出。
谨慎分配给别人的时间，以保护工作产出。

entries.prompt: What comparison did Hinds want to investigate?
options: Whether all online meetings should be replaced by coffee breaks.
Whether teams at multiple sites collaborate and innovate at the same rate as teams at one site.
Whether professors drink more coffee than graduate students.
Whether the pandemic made all workers equally spontaneous.
entries.promptZh: Hinds 想研究什么比较？
optionsZh: 所有线上会议是否都应被咖啡休息取代。
多地点团队与单地点团队的协作和创新速度是否相同。
教授喝咖啡是否比研究生多。
疫情是否使所有工作者同样自发。

entries.prompt: What pattern was reported for the geographically distributed teams in the survey?
options: More spontaneous communication, more shared identity and less task conflict.
No difference in communication or conflict from concentrated teams.
Less spontaneous communication, less shared identity and more task conflict.
The same shared identity, with all conflict permanently removed.
entries.promptZh: 调查中的地理分散团队呈现什么模式？
optionsZh: 更多自发沟通、更多共同认同、更少任务冲突。
与集中团队的沟通及冲突都没差别。
较少自发沟通、较少共同认同、更多任务冲突。
共同认同不变，所有冲突永久消失。

entries.prompt: What does “initiate” mean in the sentence?
options: Start or set in motion.
Cancel permanently after completion.
Record as a formal meeting minute.
Prove impossible under every circumstance.
entries.promptZh: 本句 initiate 是什么意思？
optionsZh: 开始；发起。
完成后永久取消。
记入正式会议纪要。
证明在所有情形都不可能。

entries.prompt: What conditions are linked to college friendships in the passage?
options: Living far apart and meeting only through appointments.
Close proximity with repeated, unplanned interactions.
Sharing exactly the same career for life.
Having no contact outside formal classes.
entries.promptZh: 本段把大学友谊与什么条件相连？
optionsZh: 住得很远，只在预约时见面。
彼此住得近，反复发生未经安排的互动。
一生从事完全相同的职业。
正式上课之外没有联系。

entries.prompt: How should “I would be surprised if” be understood here?
options: As a measured rule that no adult can ever make a close friend.
As proof that the reader has never had any college friends.
As a claim that every post-college friendship is equally close.
As the author’s expectation that matching college-level closeness is difficult, not impossible.
entries.promptZh: I would be surprised if 在这里应怎样理解？
optionsZh: 测量证实任何成年人都不能再交密友。
证明读者从未有大学朋友。
宣称毕业后每段友谊都同等亲密。
作者预期达到大学密友那样的亲密较难，而非不可能。

entries.prompt: What are “K.O.F.’s” in Williams’s quotation?
options: Friends guaranteed to remain best friends forever.
A formal experimental category based on a measured age threshold.
“Kind of friends”: situational friends, at least for now.
Only people who share the same dormitory room.
entries.promptZh: Williams 引语中的 K.O.F.’s 指什么？
optionsZh: 保证永远最好的朋友。
基于测定年龄阈值的正式实验类别。
某种程度的朋友：至少暂时是情境性朋友。
仅限同一宿舍房间的人。

entries.prompt: What explains the difficulty maintaining closeness after the pilot ended?
options: The loss of constant day-to-day interaction that had sustained the friendship.
A confirmed argument that made both women refuse any later contact.
A rule banning television writers from becoming friends.
The fact that both women had never worked together.
entries.promptZh: 试播集结束后，为什么难以维持亲密？
optionsZh: 支撑友谊的持续日常互动消失。
已证实争吵使两人拒绝此后任何联系。
规定禁止电视编剧交朋友。
两人从未一起工作。

entries.prompt: Which limited conclusion does the passage support about adult friendship?
options: Having a partner proves that every new friend will be rejected.
Parents are permanently incapable of friendship.
Distance no longer matters once someone has children.
Family commitments can make frequent, nearby, spontaneous meetings harder to arrange.
entries.promptZh: 关于成年友谊，本段支持什么有限结论？
optionsZh: 有伴侣就证明每个新朋友都会被拒绝。
父母永久无法拥有友谊。
有孩子后距离完全无关紧要。
家庭责任可能让频繁、邻近而随兴的见面更难安排。

entries.prompt: What is Moritz’s status in the account introduced here?
options: A randomly assigned participant in a train experiment.
A hypothetical person used by a philosopher to discuss planned and unplanned action.
The author’s colleague whose exact behaviour was observed in Minnesota.
A railway official collecting data on all passengers.
entries.promptZh: 本段引入的 Moritz 是什么性质的人物？
optionsZh: 火车实验中随机分派的参与者。
哲学家用来讨论计划与非计划行为的假设人物。
作者在 Minnesota 实际观察到的同事。
统计所有乘客的铁路官员。

entries.prompt: How does Moritz justify staying on the train?
options: He reasons that he could call his friends to cancel and apologise.
He has already received proof that the dinner was cancelled by his friends.
He knows the concert tickets have never existed.
He was instructed by his friends to avoid Dresden.
entries.promptZh: Moritz 怎样为继续留在火车上找理由？
optionsZh: 他想，可以打电话向朋友取消安排并道歉。
他已拿到朋友取消晚餐的证明。
他知道音乐会票从未存在。
朋友指示他避开 Dresden。

entries.prompt: What interpretation of Moritz’s action is attributed to D’Cruz?
options: It was fully planned long before the journey.
It was an experiment proving that every cancelled commitment brings happiness.
It was unpremeditated but served a deeper desire for an interesting life.
It showed that all responsibilities should always be abandoned.
entries.promptZh: 作者把 D’Cruz 对 Moritz 行为的什么解释呈现出来？
optionsZh: 旅行很久以前就已完整计划。
这是证明每次取消约定都会幸福的实验。
虽非预先深思，却满足对有趣人生的深层愿望。
所有责任都应永远抛弃。

entries.prompt: What does the author say keeping professional expertise current requires?
options: Only occasional laughter, with no attention to research.
Careful attention, a commitment of time and dedication.
Avoiding new literature and data visualisation.
Letting all knowledge remain unchanged after graduation.
entries.promptZh: 作者说，更新职业知识需要什么？
optionsZh: 只需偶尔大笑，不必关注研究。
细心关注、时间投入与努力奉献。
回避新文献和数据可视化。
毕业后让所有知识保持不变。

entries.prompt: How is the proposed link between intense focus and burnout qualified?
options: It is presented as possibly one reason, rather than the sole proven explanation.
It is established as the only cause of every athlete’s difficulties.
It means talent and determination prevent every loss of enjoyment.
It shows that sport can never become a livelihood.
entries.promptZh: 高度专注与倦怠的联系，在本段怎样被限定？
optionsZh: 它被提出为一种可能原因，而非唯一且已证明的解释。
它被确立为每位选手困难的唯一原因。
它表示天赋和决心避免每一种乐趣流失。
它说明运动永不可能成为生计。

entries.prompt: Why does the author mention other important factors at this point?
options: To withdraw the claim that athletes need hard training.
To establish that all athletes have identical personal histories.
To replace every account of difficulty with one single universal cause.
To prevent seriousness and dedication from being treated as the only explanation.
entries.promptZh: 作者在这里为什么提到其他重要因素？
optionsZh: 撤回运动员需要刻苦训练的说法。
确立所有运动员的私人经历相同。
用一个普遍单一原因替代所有困难解释。
避免把严肃和投入当成唯一解释。

entries.prompt: What does “lackluster” describe in this sporting context?
options: A performance that is guaranteed to break a world record.
An event that is never shown to any audience.
An unimpressive or disappointing performance.
A game played entirely without official rules.
entries.promptZh: 这个体育语境中，lackluster 描述什么？
optionsZh: 保证破世界纪录的表现。
从不向任何观众展示的赛事。
不出彩或令人失望的表现。
完全没有正式规则的比赛。

entries.prompt: Which balance does the author advocate in this passage?
options: Reject skill development because professionalism has no value.
Value specialisation while using playfulness to enjoy the journey beyond winning alone.
Treat the fictional film as experimental proof about every professional.
Measure a life only by whether it wins every competition.
entries.promptZh: 本段作者主张什么平衡？
optionsZh: 专业化没有价值，因此拒绝技能发展。
肯定专攻的价值，同时用玩心享受过程，不只盯获胜。
把虚构电影当作关于所有专业人士的实验证明。
只用能否赢每次比赛衡量人生。

entries.prompt: What prompted the author to suggest visiting Annapolis?
options: Seeing a road sign while driving his family between two other cities.
A previously booked cruise that required an Annapolis stop.
A formal invitation received before leaving Baltimore.
A plan to move his family permanently to Annapolis.
entries.promptZh: 什么促使作者提议去 Annapolis？
optionsZh: 开车带家人往另两城途中，看到一块路牌。
早已预订的游船要求停靠 Annapolis。
离开 Baltimore 前收到正式邀请。
计划把全家永久搬到 Annapolis。

entries.prompt: Which sequence is described after the family’s reply?
options: They rejected the suggestion and drove straight home.
They moved to Annapolis and gave up travelling.
They visited without planning, wandered around and took a cruise.
They cancelled a cruise that had been booked months earlier.
entries.promptZh: 家人回答后，发生了哪一顺序？
optionsZh: 他们拒绝建议，直接回家。
搬到 Annapolis 后放弃旅行。
未经计划前往、在城里闲逛，又乘游船。
取消几个月前订好的游船。

entries.prompt: What central point about personality and richness opens the summary?
options: Personality traits permanently fix everyone’s capacity for a rich life.
Personality alone does not determine richness; playfulness and spontaneity can be learned.
Only already-extraverted people may try new experiences.
Meaning requires avoiding every difficult task for other people.
entries.promptZh: 总结开头关于人格与丰富性的核心是什么？
optionsZh: 人格永久固定每个人丰富人生的能力。
人格本身不完全决定丰富性，人可学习玩心与自发性。
只有原本外向者才可尝试新经历。
意义要求回避一切为他人做的困难任务。

entries.prompt: How does the author qualify the admirable goals mentioned here?
options: They are declared worthless in every situation.
They require no effort or sustained attention.
Every person must pursue them on every day.
They can require sustained effort and are not for everyone or every day.
entries.promptZh: 作者怎样限定这里提到的可敬目标？
optionsZh: 在所有情况都毫无价值。
不需要努力或持续注意。
每个人每天都必须追求。

To ask the same feelings questions without changing the outcome measure.
entries.promptZh: 研究者为什么在下一实验中引入常识问答任务？
optionsZh: 核实参与者确实做过咨询顾问。
把咨询设定换成工厂流水线。
因为假想生活预测可能不准，改用行为好奇心指标。
不改变结果指标，只重问相同感受问题。

entries.prompt: What happened when participants selected the skip button?
options: They moved to the next question without seeing the answer.
They saw the answer immediately and then moved on.
They waited before receiving the current answer.
They were returned to the consulting-scenario instructions.
entries.promptZh: 参与者选择 skip 按钮时会发生什么？
optionsZh: 不看答案，直接进入下一题。
立即看到答案后再继续。
等待后得到当前答案。
回到咨询情境的说明。

entries.prompt: How was curiosity operationalized in the fifteen-question task?
options: By the speed with which a person pressed skip.
By how many answers a person was willing to wait for.
By whether a person already knew the president’s name.
By the number of seconds participants chose for each delay.
entries.promptZh: 十五题任务怎样把好奇心转化为可观察指标？
optionsZh: 按下跳过按钮的速度。
愿意等待多少个答案。
是否本来就知道总统姓名。
参与者为每次延迟自行选择多少秒。

entries.prompt: Which conclusion matches the reported behavioral comparison?
options: All working specialists became uninterested in everything beyond their jobs.
Generalists already knew more trivia answers before the task.
The study directly measured years of real consulting work.
Participants imagining a generalist role waited for answers more readily than those imagining a specialist role.
entries.promptZh: 哪项结论符合报告的行为比较？
optionsZh: 所有在职专才都对工作之外的一切失去兴趣。
任务开始前，通才已知道更多常识答案。
研究直接测量多年真实咨询工作。
想象通才角色者比想象专才角色者更愿意等待答案。

entries.prompt: What mechanism does the author propose for specialization’s selective focus?
options: Learning much about one specialty may require ignoring information outside it.
Developing deep knowledge requires attending equally to every topic.
Marketable skills remove the need to learn about one’s industry.
A healthcare consultant is shown to lack any knowledge of healthcare.
entries.promptZh: 作者提出什么机制来解释专门化的选择性注意？
optionsZh: 深入学习一个专业可能需要忽略该领域以外的信息。
形成深厚知识需要同等注意每个话题。
可就业技能消除了学习本行业的需要。
医疗顾问被证明完全不懂医疗。

entries.prompt: What does the Louvre comparison illustrate?
options: A documented study showing the Mona Lisa is less valuable than other paintings.
A deliberate decision to avoid learning anything about one’s own specialty.
Narrow attention to one focus can cause other worthwhile experiences to be missed.
Evidence that every museum visitor ignores paintings on the same side.
entries.promptZh: Louvre 的比喻要说明什么？
optionsZh: 一项证明 Mona Lisa 比其他画价值低的研究。
有意决定不学习自己的专业。
注意力过于集中在一点，可能错过其他有价值的体验。
所有博物馆参观者都忽略同一侧画作的证据。

entries.prompt: What is the primary aim of outsourcing in the examples given?
options: To learn the professional’s specialist skills.
To make routine household work take longer.
To gain time by paying someone else to do the work.
To reduce the number of household tasks that exist.
entries.promptZh: 这些例子中，外包的首要目的是什么？
optionsZh: 学习专业人士的专门技能。
让例行家务花更长时间。
付钱请别人做工作，以腾出时间。
减少家务本身的种类或数量。

entries.prompt: What does the reported survey pattern support?
options: Time-saving spending was linked with greater happiness and lower time stress in the respondents.
All respondents became happier after being randomly given cleaning services.
Material purchases were experimentally shown to cause time stress in all 4,469 respondents.
Time stress completely explained every difference in life satisfaction.
entries.promptZh: 这里报告的调查模式支持什么？
optionsZh: 在受访者中，节省时间的支出与更幸福、较少时间压力相关。
所有受访者都被随机赠送清洁服务后变得更幸福。
实验表明实物购买使全部 4,469 人产生时间压力。
时间压力完全解释生活满意度的每一项差异。

entries.prompt: How was spending compared in the experiment?
options: Two groups each spent $80 on the same weekend.
Participants freely chose whether to spend all $80 on services.
Each participant spent $40 on services and materials together in one purchase.
Participants spent $40 on a time-saving service one weekend and $40 on a material purchase another weekend.
entries.promptZh: 实验怎样比较两种支出？
optionsZh: 两组各在同一周末花八十美元。
参与者自由选择是否把八十美元全用于服务。
每人一次购买把四十美元同时用于服务和实物。
参与者一个周末用四十美元购买省时服务，另一周末用四十美元买实物。

entries.prompt: What relationship is reported between time pressure and happiness?
options: Greater time pressure was associated with greater happiness.
Lower time pressure went with higher reported happiness.
Time pressure stayed identical after both kinds of spending.
Lower time pressure eliminated every negative feeling.
entries.promptZh: 原文报告时间压力与幸福有什么关系？
optionsZh: 时间压力越大，幸福越高。
时间压力越低，报告的幸福越高。
两种支出后的时间压力完全相同。
较低时间压力消除了每一种消极情绪。

entries.prompt: Whose perspective qualifies the claim about repetitive tasks and working conditions?
options: Only the professional hired to perform the task.
Every person involved in the outsourcing arrangement.
At least the person paying for the service.
Only workers on a factory assembly line.
entries.promptZh: 关于重复劳动和工作条件的陈述，原文限定在哪一方的视角？
optionsZh: 只限被雇来做事的专业人士。
外包安排中的每一个人。
至少指付钱购买服务的人。
只限工厂流水线工人。

entries.prompt: Which statement preserves the evidence status of this claim?
options: A reduction in richness is possible, but the authors have not tested it empirically.
The authors’ experiment conclusively proved that outsourcing reduces richness.
The authors have ruled out any effect on psychological richness.
The authors have tested only workers and confirmed the effect for purchasers.
entries.promptZh: 哪一陈述保留了这项主张的证据状态？
optionsZh: 丰富性可能减少，但作者尚未做实证检验。
作者的实验已确凿证明外包降低丰富性。
作者已排除外包对丰富性的任何影响。
作者只检验了工人，却确认了购买者的效果。

entries.prompt: What made the couple consider doing the patio work themselves?
options: A contractor guaranteed they would finish for $4,000.
They had already earned $9,000 by selling the bricks.
They had confirmed the final project would save exactly $5,000.
The lowest quote was $9,000 while materials were about $4,000.
entries.promptZh: 什么让夫妇考虑亲自动手修露台？
optionsZh: 承包商保证四千美元全部完工。
他们已通过卖砖赚了九千美元。
他们已确认最终恰好节省五千美元。
最低报价九千美元，而材料约四千美元。

entries.prompt: How did the couple’s later experience compare with their initial impression?
options: The videos made the work seem impossible, but it proved effortless.
The work seemed manageable at first but required much more effort than expected.
They hired the video makers to complete all of the work.
They had anticipated the full workload before deciding to begin.
entries.promptZh: 实际经历与夫妇最初的印象有什么差异？
optionsZh: 视频使工程看似不可能，实际却毫不费力。
起初看似可行，实际劳动远超预期。
他们雇视频制作者完成全部工作。
决定开工前，他们已完全预料工作量。

entries.prompt: What does “taxing” mean in the description of preparing the ground?
options: Requiring payment of a government charge.
Increasing the value of the house automatically.
Physically demanding and tiring.
Reducing the number of bricks needed.
entries.promptZh: 在准备地面的描述中，taxing 是什么意思？
optionsZh: 需要缴纳政府税费。
自动提高房屋价值。
费体力、令人疲惫的。
减少所需砖块数量。

entries.prompt: What reaction to the DIY decision is reported during the project?
options: They consistently felt certain they had made the best choice.
They blamed only the contractor who had done the work.
They regretted spending the project’s entire budget on hired labor.
They repeatedly questioned the choice and regretted not hiring help.
entries.promptZh: 项目进行时，他们对 DIY 决定有什么反应？
optionsZh: 始终确信自己作了最佳选择。
只责怪完成工程的承包商。
后悔把全部预算花在雇人上。
反复质疑选择，后悔没请人来做。

entries.prompt: What uncertainty remains in the author’s assessment after completion?
options: Whether much money was really saved once their time was considered.
Whether they had completed the patio at all.
Whether the hired contractor actually took three months.
Whether their result was better than professional work.
entries.promptZh: 完工后的评价中，作者仍不确定什么？
optionsZh: 考虑投入时间后，究竟有没有省下很多钱。
是否真的完成了露台。
已雇承包商是否实际做了三个月。
他们的成果是否胜过专业施工。

entries.prompt: What contrast is introduced by “And yet” at the start?
options: The author no longer remembers anything about the project.
The project remained memorable years later despite the earlier difficulties.
Seeing a snake made the author an experienced bricklayer immediately.
The family had outsourced the entire project before the snake appeared.
entries.promptZh: 开头的 And yet 引出什么对比？
optionsZh: 作者已不记得工程的任何事情。
尽管先前很艰难，多年后项目仍留下可谈的记忆。
见到蛇使作者立即成为熟练砌砖工。
蛇出现前，全家已把整个工程外包。

entries.prompt: What new ability does the author say he discovered?
options: He was already an expert at every kind of repair.
He could safely remove every kind of snake.
He was reasonably good at brick edging.
He could finish any patio faster than a professional.
entries.promptZh: 作者说自己发现了什么新能力？
optionsZh: 自己本来就是各种维修的专家。
能安全处理各种蛇。
自己在砌砖收边方面还不错。
能比专业人士更快完成任何露台。

entries.prompt: How does the author distinguish short-run and long-run consequences?
options: Hiring help might have brought more short-run happiness, while doing it themselves left a richer store of stories and emotions.
Doing it themselves produced no negative feelings at the time and no later memories.
Hiring help actually gave them all the same stories while removing every cost.
The project guaranteed permanent happiness and erased memories of pain.
entries.promptZh: 作者怎样区分短期与长期后果？
optionsZh: 雇人本可能增加短期幸福，亲手做则留下更多故事与情绪记忆。
亲手做当时毫无负面感受，后来也无记忆。
雇人实际上既给了相同故事又去除所有成本。
工程保证永久幸福，并抹去痛苦记忆。

entries.prompt: What distinction does the author draw between routine cleaning and building a patio?
options: Both are said to offer exactly the same stories and learning.
Outsourcing any routine task is presented as a serious mistake.
Patio building is described as easier than cleaning the house.
Outsourcing an unusual project may forgo richer experiences, whereas routine cleaning is portrayed as offering few stories.
entries.promptZh: 作者在例行清洁与建露台之间作了什么区分？
optionsZh: 两者提供完全相同的故事和学习。
把任何日常任务外包都是严重错误。
建露台比打扫房屋容易。
外包特别项目可能错过丰富体验，而日常清洁被描写为较少产生故事。

entries.prompt: Which paraphrase best matches the warning about hiring someone?
options: Hiring someone deliberately removes every source of happiness.
Paying for the work may unintentionally mean missing a potentially enriching experience.
Every hired worker prevents the employer from learning any skill.
An interesting life story can only come from unpaid manual work.
entries.promptZh: 哪种改写最符合关于雇人代做的提醒？
optionsZh: 雇人会有意消除每个幸福来源。
付费请人做可能无意间让自己错过一段潜在的丰富体验。
每个雇工都阻止雇主学习任何技能。
有趣人生故事只能来自无薪体力劳动。

entries.prompt: What shared point is illustrated by the motorcycle, patio and generalist examples?
options: Richer engagement may require taking on a harder or broader task rather than the easiest route.
Specialization always demands broader perspectives than generalist work.
Building a patio is presented as less demanding than hiring someone.
Efficiency and psychological richness are defined as exactly the same thing.
entries.promptZh: 摩托车、露台和通才的例子共同说明什么？
optionsZh: 更丰富的投入可能要求承担更难或更广的任务，而非最省事的路。
专才工作总比通才工作要求更广视角。
建露台被说成比雇人更轻松。
效率与心理丰富性被定义为同一回事。

entries.prompt: What trade-off should the two self-directed questions help a reader consider?
options: Whether every familiar activity guarantees lifelong richness.
Whether all negative emotions should be eliminated before starting any task.
Whether doing a challenging job oneself could yield a story despite short-run discomfort.
Whether hiring someone always produces more stories than doing it oneself.
entries.promptZh: 这两个向自己提的问题，帮助读者考虑什么取舍？
optionsZh: 每项熟悉活动是否保证终身丰富。
开始任务前是否必须消除所有负面情绪。
尽管短期可能不舒服，亲手完成挑战是否能留下故事。
雇人是否总比亲手做产生更多故事。

entries.prompt: What change does the closing invitation recommend?
options: Never paying attention to productivity in any area of life.
Replacing all paid work permanently with bread making.
Finding the fastest available method for every everyday activity.
Occasionally choosing a slower hands-on way to add variety to life.
entries.promptZh: 结尾的邀请建议作什么改变？
optionsZh: 生活任何领域都永不考虑生产力。
永久把所有有偿工作换成烤面包。
为每项日常活动寻找最快方法。
偶尔选较慢、亲手做的方式，为生活增添变化。

entries.prompt: What question opens the discussion of aesthetic experience?
options: Whether direct experiences have ever been discussed before.
Whether reading novels can offer richness comparable to direct experiences.
Whether building a patio is a form of publishing a novel.
Whether study abroad is the only possible source of richness.
entries.promptZh: 关于审美体验的讨论以什么问题开头？
optionsZh: 此前是否曾讨论直接体验。
读小说能否提供与直接体验相似的心理丰富性。
建露台是否是一种出版小说的行为。
留学是否是心理丰富性的唯一来源。

entries.prompt: What purpose is given for Aziz’s becoming a fisherman?
options: To make a living and try to realize his dream of finishing high school.
To finance a bookstore he already owned at age six.
To avoid ever returning to education because he disliked books.
To retire from bookselling after a completed university degree.
entries.promptZh: 原文说 Aziz 为什么成为渔夫？
optionsZh: 谋生，并努力实现高中毕业的梦想。
为六岁时已拥有的书店筹款。
因讨厌书而永不再上学。
大学毕业后从卖书退休。

entries.prompt: What forced Aziz to leave school at fifteen?
options: His lack of interest in reading novels.
The cost of maintaining a bookstore he already owned.
The high price of textbooks.
A requirement to spend eight hours a day selling books.
entries.promptZh: 什么迫使 Aziz 十五岁时退学？
optionsZh: 他对读小说毫无兴趣。
维持已拥有书店的费用。
教材价格高昂。
每天必须卖书八小时的规定。

entries.prompt: What is meant by Aziz’s statement about living more than 4,000 lives?
options: He has held more than 4,000 paid jobs during his lifetime.
Reading many books has let him imaginatively experience many lives.
He has taken more than 4,000 separate vacations.
The passage reports a scientific count of literal reincarnations.
entries.promptZh: Aziz 所说活过四千多种人生是什么意思？
optionsZh: 一生做过四千多份有薪工作。
阅读许多书，让他在想象中体验许多人生。
他已度过四千多次独立假期。
片段报告对真实轮回次数的科学计数。

entries.prompt: Where did the dramatic events filling Proust’s afternoons take place?
options: In journeys he physically made during every afternoon.
In experiments comparing readers with nonreaders.
In meetings with the novelist at his house.
In the book he was reading.
entries.promptZh: 填满 Proust 下午时光的戏剧性事件发生在哪里？
optionsZh: 他每个下午亲身进行的旅行中。
比较读者与不读书者的实验中。
他家中与小说家的会面中。
他正在阅读的书中。

entries.prompt: What conclusion does the author draw from the novelist’s power described here?
options: Books can make a psychologically rich life possible through access to many emotions.
Only direct travel can reveal emotions to a reader.
Every reader is guaranteed to feel all emotions within exactly one hour.
Reading removes the need for any firsthand experience in every life.
entries.promptZh: 作者从这里描述的小说家力量得出什么结论？
optionsZh: 书能让人接触多种情绪，从而使心理丰富人生成为可能。
只有亲自旅行能让读者认识情绪。
每位读者都保证在恰好一小时内体验全部情绪。
阅读使每个人都不再需要任何亲身体验。

entries.prompt: What does the author see in The Remains of the Day beyond an engaging story?
options: A practical manual for managing a household.
An exploration of moral dilemmas and life’s meaning.
A statistical history of every British butler.
A film review concerned only with the actors.
entries.promptZh: 作者认为 The Remains of the Day 除了引人入胜的故事，还探讨什么？
optionsZh: 管理家务的实用手册。
道德困境与人生意义。
所有英国管家的统计史。
只关注演员的影评。

entries.prompt: What changed for Stevens after the Hall was sold?
options: He became the American owner of the estate.
His staff expanded and he abandoned all holidays.
He continued managing twenty-eight people without interruption.
He managed only four staff and received his first real professional vacation.
entries.promptZh: 庄园售出后，Stevens 的处境发生什么变化？
optionsZh: 成为庄园的美国主人。
员工增加，并放弃一切假期。
一直管理二十八人，没有变化。
只管理四名员工，并得到职业生涯首次真正假期。

entries.prompt: What does Stevens now have time to reflect upon?
options: His life so far and his service to Lord Darlington.
Only the future profits from selling the Hall.
The film actor’s career rather than his own life.
A new career he has already begun abroad.
entries.promptZh: Stevens 此时有时间反思什么？
optionsZh: 此前的人生及为 Darlington 服务的岁月。
只反思出售庄园的未来利润。
电影演员的生涯，而非自己。
已经开始的海外新职业。

entries.prompt: What moral question does the passage raise about Stevens’s dedication?
options: Whether a clear purpose necessarily proves that its cause is good.
Whether Darlington’s actions were harmless to England.
Whether dedication retains value when the cause served proves morally compromised.
Whether Stevens secretly opposed Darlington throughout the war.
entries.promptZh: 片段就 Stevens 的奉献提出什么道德问题？
optionsZh: 目标明确是否必能证明目标善良。
Darlington 的行为是否对英国无害。
所服务事业道德有问题时，奉献本身是否仍有价值。
Stevens 是否整个战争中都暗中反对主人。

entries.prompt: Which view is expressed by Stevens in this quotation?
options: Darlington chose the correct path and caused no harm.
Darlington chose his own path, even though it proved misguided.
Darlington never made any choices for himself.
The author has experimentally established Darlington’s courage.
entries.promptZh: 这段引语中，Stevens 表达什么看法？
optionsZh: Darlington 道路正确且未造成伤害。
Darlington 至少自行选过道路，尽管后来证明误入歧途。
Darlington 从未自行选择。
作者通过实验证明其勇气。

entries.prompt: What does Stevens emphasize about his own service?
options: He relied on his lord’s wisdom and believed his work was worthwhile.
He had independently designed every political action.
He had known all along that his work was pointless.
He had never trusted Darlington at any time.
entries.promptZh: Stevens 强调自己服务经历中的什么？
optionsZh: 依赖主人的智慧，相信自己在做值得的事。
每个政治行动都由他独立设计。
一直明知工作毫无价值。
从未信任过主人。

entries.prompt: What new concern did reading the novel prompt in the author?
options: Whether the novel was a literal record of his own travels.
Whether every act of dedication necessarily benefits humanity.
Whether he should become a British butler immediately.
Whether his own dedication could be misguided and do more harm than good.
entries.promptZh: 读小说使作者产生什么新忧虑？
optionsZh: 小说是否真实记录了自己的旅行。
每种奉献是否必然有益人类。
是否应立即成为英国管家。
自己的奉献是否也可能方向错误，害处大于益处。

entries.prompt: How did the unsettling thought affect the reading experience?
options: It made the author happy by proving all historical actions justified.
It left his view of history completely unchanged.
It was unhappy but made the experience deeper and richer.
It proved that he had actually served as a wartime colonel.
entries.promptZh: 这个令人不安的想法怎样影响阅读体验？
optionsZh: 证明历史行为都正当，令作者幸福。
完全未改变历史看法。
想法不快乐，却让体验更深、更丰富。
证明他确实曾任战时上校。

entries.prompt: What does “transportation” mean in the psychological description?
options: Physical travel to the location where a film was shot.
Deep immersion in a narrative through attention, imagery and feeling.
Moving a book from one room to another.
The claim that every reading experience is enriching.
entries.promptZh: 心理学描述中的 transportation 是什么意思？
optionsZh: 实际去电影拍摄地旅行。
注意、想象与情感深深融入叙事。
把书搬到另一房间。
每次阅读都能丰富人生的主张。

entries.prompt: What requirement is added beyond immersion?
options: The experience must involve actual travel.
The plot must be forgotten within a few days.
The story must contain no emotional events.
The experience must also be memorable.
entries.promptZh: 除了沉浸，还增加什么要求？
optionsZh: 必须实际旅行。
必须几天内忘记情节。
故事不能有情绪事件。
体验还必须让人记得。

entries.prompt: How is retaining an experience related to richness here?
options: Retention is presented as necessary for the experience to enrich one’s life.
Retention alone is said to guarantee every form of richness.
Forgetting is presented as the key to enrichment.
Vivid memories are said to prevent indirect experiences.
entries.promptZh: 这里保留体验记忆与丰富性有什么关系？
optionsZh: 保留记忆被视为体验丰富人生的必要条件。
只要记住，就保证所有丰富性。
遗忘被视为丰富人生的关键。
鲜明记忆会阻止间接体验。

entries.prompt: What does the comparison with high earners illustrate?
options: Frequent travel always produces a satisfying life.
Psychological richness requires literally earning more money.
Having many experiences need not build lasting richness if they do not accumulate.
All sensation-seekers have low incomes.
entries.promptZh: 与高收入者的比较说明什么？
optionsZh: 频繁旅行总会带来满意人生。
丰富性要求真的赚更多钱。
若体验未积累，经历很多也未必形成持续丰富性。
所有寻刺激者收入都低。

entries.prompt: What corresponds to saving money in the psychological-richness analogy?
options: Constantly replacing one experience with another.
Remembering and cherishing one’s experiences.
Avoiding all new experiences.
Turning each memory into a financial asset.
entries.promptZh: 心理丰富性的类比中，什么对应于存钱？
optionsZh: 不断用新体验替换旧体验。
记住并珍惜自己的经历。
避开全部新体验。
把每个记忆变成金融资产。

entries.prompt: Why did the author not find Home Alone particularly rich?
options: It lacked much complexity and did not change his perspective.
It was neither immersive nor fun.
He could not remember anything about it.
It prevented every viewer from reflecting on life.
entries.promptZh: 作者为什么不觉得 Home Alone 特别丰富？
optionsZh: 不够复杂，也未改变他的视角。
既不沉浸也无趣。
他完全记不起电影。
它阻止所有观众反思人生。

entries.prompt: What narrative feature of Rashomon is described?
options: Four unrelated crimes are solved by one consistent witness.
The audience receives one account that nobody disputes.
The final version is identified here as objectively proven true.
Four characters give conflicting but convincing accounts of one event.
entries.promptZh: 这里描述 Rashomon 的什么叙事特点？
optionsZh: 四件无关案件由同一证人解决。
只有一个无人争议的版本。
本段指出最终版本已客观证实。
四个人对同一事件给出冲突却可信的叙述。

entries.prompt: How did the final event change the author’s response to Rashomon?
options: It confirmed that human goodness could never exist.
It made the film less memorable by removing all emotion.
It shifted a bleak view toward hope through an unexpected example of goodness.
It proved that human memory is always accurate.
entries.promptZh: 最终事件怎样改变作者对 Rashomon 的反应？
optionsZh: 确认人不可能善良。
移除所有情绪，使电影不再难忘。
意外善举使灰暗看法转向希望。
证明人类记忆总准确。

entries.prompt: Which memorable contrast in The Matrix is mentioned?
options: The choice between red and blue pills and confusion about reality and virtual reality.
A choice between two different books about Japan.
A demonstrated absence of any confusion about reality.
A comparison of the acting in Rashomon and Home Alone.
entries.promptZh: 这里提到 The Matrix 哪个令人记得的对照？
optionsZh: 红蓝药丸的选择，以及现实与虚拟现实的混淆。
两本日本题材书的选择。
证明现实从不让人困惑。
比较 Rashomon 与 Home Alone 的演技。

entries.prompt: What does “blind you from the truth” suggest in the quoted dialogue?
options: A medical diagnosis of permanent physical blindness.
A deceptive world preventing someone from recognizing the truth.
A request to close the window before watching a film.
A scientific finding about every person in the real world.
entries.promptZh: 引述台词中的 blind you from the truth 暗示什么？
optionsZh: 永久失明的医学诊断。
一个欺骗性世界使人看不到真相。
看电影前关窗的请求。
关于现实每个人的科学发现。

entries.prompt: How does Morpheus describe the prison in this fragment?
options: As a place Neo has already escaped by physical force.
As an ordinary room that can be explored with all the senses.
As a prison whose existence has been scientifically proved outside the film.
As something a person cannot taste, see or touch.
entries.promptZh: Morpheus 在当前片段中怎样描述监狱？
optionsZh: Neo 已用武力逃出的地方。
可用所有感官探索的普通房间。
电影以外已科学证明存在的监狱。
人不能尝、看或触碰的东西。

entries.prompt: What does “Gradually” indicate about understanding the characters’ situation?
options: Understanding arrives fully before the story begins.
The characters’ situation never becomes clearer.
Recognition develops over time rather than all at once.
Only a physical prison can explain the story.
entries.promptZh: Gradually 表明对角色处境的理解怎样形成？
optionsZh: 故事开始前已完全了解。
处境永不会更清楚。
认识逐步发展，而非一次全部出现。
只有实体监狱能解释故事。

entries.prompt: How do the Kim children challenge the stereotype described?
options: They are portrayed as smart and stylish despite stereotypes of the poor as incompetent.
They are wealthy children whom the film portrays as incapable.
They prove that every poor person has the same abilities.
They never interact with the wealthy family.
entries.promptZh: Kim 家孩子怎样挑战所述刻板印象？
optionsZh: 贫者常被视为无能，他们却聪明、时髦。
他们是被说成无能的富家孩子。
证明所有贫者能力都相同。
从不接触富裕家庭。

entries.prompt: How do the claimed identities match the tutoring jobs?
options: Elite student for art tutoring; artist for English tutoring.
Artist for art tutoring; elite student for English tutoring.
Both claim to be artists to teach English.
Both truthfully report completed elite university degrees.
entries.promptZh: 声称的身份与家教职位怎样对应？
optionsZh: 名校学生教艺术，艺术家教英语。
艺术家教艺术，名校学生教英语。
两人都称艺术家来教英语。
两人都如实报告已获名校学位。

entries.prompt: What is the function of Ms. Kim’s explanation?
options: It establishes experimentally that wealth always causes kindness.
It says poverty makes kindness impossible for every person.
It rejects any link between circumstances and behavior.
It invites reconsideration of kindness in relation to economic circumstances.
entries.promptZh: Kim 太太的解释起什么作用？
optionsZh: 实验确立财富总能导致善良。
认定贫穷使每个人都不可能善良。
否认处境与行为的任何联系。
引导重新考虑善良与经济处境的关系。

entries.prompt: How does Kant characterize pleasant arts in the quoted passage?
options: As directed merely toward enjoyment and making time pass unnoticed.
As necessarily changing every person’s moral beliefs.
As devoid of any capacity to please people together.
As a scientific test of the psychological effects of games.
entries.promptZh: Kant 的引语怎样界定 pleasant arts？
optionsZh: 仅以享受、让时间不知不觉流逝为方向。
必定改变每个人的道德信念。
完全不能使聚在一起的人愉悦。
检验游戏心理效果的科学实验。

entries.prompt: What distinguishes reflective judgment from mere sensation here?
options: It excludes any mental representation of an object.
It is simply the same as passing time pleasantly.
It involves a gap between sensation and reality and a new mental understanding.
It guarantees that all viewers perceive an object identically.
entries.promptZh: 这里的反思判断与单纯感觉有什么区别？
optionsZh: 排除对对象的任何心理表征。
仅等同于愉快打发时间。
涉及感觉与现实的差距，以及新的心理理解。
保证所有观众理解完全一致。

entries.prompt: What contrast does Rollins draw between physical existence and art?
options: Technology guarantees that every life has meaning.
Art is simply another way to earn money and watch screens.
Meeting physical needs alone does not supply the significance he attributes to art.
Physical existence is described as impossible without modern screens.
entries.promptZh: Rollins 如何对比物质生存与艺术？
optionsZh: 科技保证每个人生有意义。
艺术只是赚钱和看屏幕的另一方式。
仅满足物质需要，并不具有他赋予艺术的意义。
没有现代屏幕就不可能生存。

entries.prompt: What two effects of art are paired at the end of Rollins’s quotation?
options: Encouraging exploration and revealing the limits of what we know.
Eliminating intuition and making every political view identical.
Preventing new discoveries and confirming complete knowledge.
Replacing every emotional experience with a new fact.
entries.promptZh: Rollins 引语末尾并列艺术哪两项作用？
optionsZh: 鼓励探索，显露我们所知的局限。
消除直觉，使政治观点一致。
阻止发现，确认已知一切。
用新事实替代全部情感体验。

entries.prompt: What does Brooks say he is trying to counteract?
options: Spending too much time learning a musical instrument.
A complete lack of interest in any public issue.
His inability to find any works of art.
Being too caught up in politics.
entries.promptZh: Brooks 说自己试图应对什么？
optionsZh: 学乐器耗时太多。
完全不关心公共议题。
找不到任何艺术作品。
过度卷入政治。

entries.prompt: What benefit of art does Brooks emphasize?
options: Its value depends entirely on teaching a new factual claim.
It expands emotional experience rather than merely adding facts.
It prevents viewers from responding with awe.
It works only through novels and never through visual art.
entries.promptZh: Brooks 强调艺术什么益处？
optionsZh: 价值完全取决于教会新事实。
扩大情感体验，而不只是增加事实。
阻止观者敬畏。
只靠小说，视觉艺术无效。

entries.prompt: What problem is associated with “Das Gerede” in this account?
options: It leaves people with too much independent reflection.
It prevents any information from being passed between people.
It obscures importance through repeated chatter and distraction instead of deep thought.
It refers only to incorrect pronunciation of philosophical terms.
entries.promptZh: 这里的 Das Gerede 有什么问题？
optionsZh: 使人独立深思过多。
阻止人们传递任何信息。
以不断闲谈和分心代替深思，遮蔽重要之事。
只指哲学术语发音错误。

entries.prompt: What consequence of chatter and distractions is described?
options: They leave little room for deep thinking or encounters with the sublime.
They guarantee a stable feeling of rootedness.
They remove all tasks from people’s to-do lists.
They prove that every conversation is equally harmful.
entries.promptZh: 闲谈与分心带来什么后果？
optionsZh: 很少留下深思或接近崇高之物的空间。
保证人有稳定的扎根感。
移除待办清单的一切任务。
证明每种谈话都同样有害。

entries.prompt: How certain is the author about the role of Rothko’s biography in his response?
options: He reports a controlled experiment proving the role of biography.
He says biography cannot influence any viewer.
He states that depression necessarily improves artistic quality.
He offers background knowledge as a possible explanation, not a certainty.
entries.promptZh: 作者多确定 Rothko 生平知识对自身反应的作用？
optionsZh: 报告受控实验已证明生平的作用。
说生平不会影响任何观者。
断言抑郁必定提高艺术质量。
把背景知识作为一种可能解释，而非定论。

entries.prompt: What does the opening “Or maybe” do?
options: It cancels the author’s report of ever visiting the museum.
It introduces the alternative that biography may not explain the reaction.
It proves that the painting has no emotional effect.
It identifies a second painting as the only possible cause.
entries.promptZh: 开头 Or maybe 起什么作用？
optionsZh: 取消曾到博物馆的陈述。
提出另一可能：生平知识也许不解释反应。
证明画没有情感作用。
认定另一幅画是唯一原因。

entries.prompt: What distinction does Rothko’s quotation emphasize?
options: A painting can only report an event that happened to its creator.
Art has value only when its biography is fully known.
Encountering a painting can itself constitute an experience.
Paintings and experiences are defined as unrelated things.
entries.promptZh: Rothko 的引语强调什么区别？
optionsZh: 画只能报告创作者亲历事件。
只有完全知道生平艺术才有价值。
面对一幅画，本身就可以构成体验。
画与体验被定义为互不相关。

entries.prompt: What general distinction did Berlyne report?
options: The same complexity level always maximized pleasure and interest.
Complex figures were typically more pleasant and less interesting.
Simple figures were always both unpleasant and uninteresting.
Pleasantness and interestingness had different optimal complexity levels.
entries.promptZh: Berlyne 报告什么一般区别？
optionsZh: 同一复杂度总使愉悦和趣味同时最高。
复杂图通常更愉悦、更无趣。
简单图总是不愉悦又无趣。
愉悦与趣味各有不同最佳复杂度。

entries.prompt: Which two factors were manipulated in the geometric-figure experiment?
options: Symmetry and the number of elements.
Color and the participants’ income.
The artist’s biography and political views.
Whether participants had studied novels in childhood.
entries.promptZh: 几何图形实验操纵哪两个因素？
optionsZh: 对称性与元素数量。
颜色与参与者收入。
艺术家的生平与政见。
童年是否读过小说。

options: The most pleasing figures were also the most interesting.

Complexity increased pleasantness and reduced interest.
Asymmetry made no difference to either judgment.

optionsZh: 最愉悦的也最有趣。
最愉悦的简单对称图反而最无趣。
复杂性提高愉悦、降低趣味。
不对称对两评价都无影响。

options: Seven calming and six disturbing paintings.
Thirteen calming paintings and no disturbing ones.
Six calming and seven disturbing paintings.
Six geometric figures and seven poems.

十三幅都平静，没有扰人的。
六幅平静、七幅扰人。
六个几何图与七首诗。

options: Comprehensibility, familiarity and simplicity.
Disturbingness and unpleasantness alone.
The number of novels read by the artist.
Participants’ ability to identify the painter’s death date.
entries.promptZh: 哪些特征预测愉悦评分？
optionsZh: 可理解性、熟悉性与简单性。
只有扰人程度和不愉悦。
画家读过的小说数量。
参与者识别画家死亡日期的能力。

The findings prove all distressing events enrich real life.

optionsZh: 只有平静画被认为有趣。
趣味和不愉悦总反向变化。
结果证明所有现实痛苦事件都丰富人生。

Only one group was permitted to report interest.

optionsZh: 读完全不同的诗。
其中一组获得同一首诗的背景信息。
一组被要求在所有条件下避开标题。

options: At least a minimal degree of comprehensibility.
Complete simplicity with no ambiguity.

A requirement to know every detail of the artist’s life.
entries.promptZh: 欣赏艺术需要什么条件？
optionsZh: 至少最低程度的可理解性。
完全简单且无歧义。
对每个观众都完全难懂。
必须知道艺术家全部生平细节。

options: Only their scores on a randomly assigned childhood reading program.
Only their parents’ political views and school grades.
Childhood reading habits, current cognitive styles and perceived richness.
The physiological effects of viewing Rothko paintings.

optionsZh: 仅询问随机分配的童年阅读项目得分。
仅父母政见与学校成绩。
童年阅读习惯、当前认知风格和自觉丰富性。
观看 Rothko 画作的生理反应。

entries.prompt: What does the second sentence signal about the original assumption?
options: It confirms every genre had an identical effect.
It proves reading was randomly assigned in childhood.
It says the researchers had made no prediction.
The findings were more complicated than the general prediction.
entries.promptZh: 第二句怎样回应最初假设？
optionsZh: 确认每类书效果相同。
证明童年阅读被随机分配。
说研究者完全没作预测。
结果比一般性预测更复杂。

options: Literary-fiction readers were less attributionally complex; romance readers more so.

Both groups were reported to have exactly identical cognitive styles.
The researchers assigned adults to become lifelong romance readers.
entries.promptZh: 报告了两类童年阅读群体什么差别？
optionsZh: 文学小说读者归因复杂性较低，言情读者较高。
文学小说读者较高，而大量言情读者较低。
两组认知风格完全一样。
研究者把成人随机变成终身言情读者。

entries.prompt: What contrast does the example of Joe illustrate?
options: A single fixed label versus recognizing behavior may vary across relationships.
Proof that Joe is a real participant who always behaves identically.
Evidence that every romance reader dislikes both sport and opera.
The claim that no one can ever act generously.
entries.promptZh: Joe 的例子说明什么对比？
optionsZh: 单一固定标签，与认识行为可随关系而不同。
证明 Joe 是实际参与者且总行为一致。
证明每位言情读者都讨厌运动和歌剧。
没人能慷慨的主张。

entries.prompt: What does the statistical-control result support?
options: Every possible confounder was removed and causation proved.
Age, gender and education were randomly assigned.
The association persisted after accounting for the listed demographic and political variables.
Reading habits had no relationship with cognitive complexity.
entries.promptZh: 统计控制结果支持什么？
optionsZh: 排除所有混杂因素，并证明因果。
年龄、性别和教育被随机分配。
考虑列出的人口与政治变量后，关联仍存在。
阅读习惯与认知复杂性无关系。

entries.prompt: What limitation accompanies the empirical support for Trilling’s thesis?
options: The studies measured only historical book prices.
No relationship was observed at all.
Reading was experimentally proved to cause all reported differences.
The studies were correlational, leaving causality for future tests.
entries.promptZh: 对 Trilling 论点的实证支持附带什么限制？
optionsZh: 研究只测历史书价。
完全没发现关系。
实验已证明阅读造成全部差异。
研究是相关性的，因果仍需未来检验。

entries.prompt: What does “perspective-taking” mean in the passage?
options: Judging behavior only from an outside observer’s viewpoint.
Seeing another person’s behavior from that person’s own perspective.
Taking photographs of people from several camera angles.
Assuming every character has an identical motive.
entries.promptZh: 本段 perspective-taking 是什么意思？
optionsZh: 只从外部观察者角度评判行为。
从行为者自身视角看其行为。
从多个镜头角度拍人。
假设所有角色动机一致。

entries.prompt: What question is introduced for the new series of experiments?

Whether the earlier correlational survey had already proved causality.
Whether every painting has exactly the same complexity.
Whether perspective change has already been empirically confirmed in all contexts.
entries.promptZh: 新一系列实验引入什么问题？
optionsZh: 多视角图是否比单视角图在视觉上更丰富。
此前相关调查是否已证明因果。
每幅画是否复杂度完全相同。
视角改变是否已在所有场景实证确认。

entries.prompt: What did participants do after answering the first question about the drawing?

They immediately rated their happiness without seeing another question.
They drew a different beer glass from memory.
They moved to another page asking what else they could see.
entries.promptZh: 回答关于画的第一个问题后，参与者做了什么？
optionsZh: 得到正确解释的说明。
不再看其他问题，立即评幸福。
凭记忆另画一杯啤酒。
到另一页回答还能看见什么。

options: Everyone sees a face first and never sees a glass.

Only the researchers see either object.
All participants report the same view at every stage.
entries.promptZh: 原文描述怎样的观看顺序？
optionsZh: 所有人先见脸，永不见杯。
大多数先见啤酒，后来许多人见脸。
只有研究者能看见任一物体。
所有阶段人人看法相同。

entries.prompt: What was removed to make the altered image?

All of the foam and the background.
The bubble that had functioned as an eye.
The question asking participants what they saw.

optionsZh: 整个啤酒杯。
全部泡沫与背景。
原先充当眼睛的气泡。
询问看见什么的问题。

Every participant reported both views.
They were explicitly instructed to draw faces.
entries.promptZh: 修改图组关于看见脸的报告是什么？
optionsZh: 没有人看见脸。
大多数先见脸再见啤酒。
每个人都报告两种视图。

They evaluated the drawings and reported their current moods.
entries.promptZh: 写完图像观察后，所有参与者做什么？
optionsZh: 只报告童年阅读习惯。
获知哪个组赢了实验。
自己修改次要物体。
评价图画并报告当前心情。
